title: Scenario 12: the disconnect ClearPass cannot send
task: Security wants employee.user off the network now, from ClearPass. Open the laptop's row in the ClearPass panel and use Change Status. Make the switch take a disconnect from ClearPass (192.0.2.10, shared secret cppm-lab-key), then find the profile that actually ends the session. The ClearPass side only tells you so much; the switch's counters say the rest.
hints: The first Change Status fails with no reason on the ClearPass side. `show radius dyn-authorization`: an invalid client address, because 192.0.2.10 is not a dynamic authorization client yet.
`radius dyn-authorization client 192.0.2.10 secret-key plaintext cppm-lab-key`. Enabling dynamic authorization is only half of it.

Now the default profile, ArubaOS Wireless Terminate Session, gets Disconnect-NAK with Missing-Attribute. It sends only Calling-Station-Id, and the switch's default strict mode wants NAS-IP-Address or NAS-Identifier. Pick AOS-CX Disconnect.
AOS-CX Bounce Switch Port is the one the switch counts as a CoA. It flaps the port, which on a phone port drops the phone and the PC behind it.

checks.desc: 192.0.2.10 is a dynamic authorization client with the right secret
You saw the default profile refused (a Disconnect-NAK)
A disconnect from ClearPass was acknowledged by the switch
